## The one guard

`ensurePermission` is the only guard this layer generates. Every guarded route's
`beforeLoad` should call it:

```ts
export const Route = createFileRoute("/_private/admin")({
  beforeLoad: async ({ context }) => {
    await ensurePermission(context.queryClient, PERMISSIONS.roles.assign);
  },
});
```

Do not inline a second, ad-hoc permission check next to this one, and do not
build a second guard helper alongside it - a route is either protected by this
call or it isn't, and a duplicate path is how a guard gap gets introduced later.
No `<PermissionGate>` component is generated either: use `hasPermission(...)` in
JSX conditionals and to filter nav items instead.
